**34 years.** The U.S. declared independence on **July 4, 1776**, while Mexico’s declared independence is conventionally dated **September 16, 1810** — so 1810 − 1776 = **34 years**.

Sources: [U.S. State Department](https://history.state.gov/milestones/1776-1783/declaration), [CIA World Factbook archive for Mexico](https://worldfactbookarchive.org/archive/field/MX/Independence)

*(Mexico’s formal “Acta Solemne” declaration was in 1813, which would give 37 years, but 1810 is the standard declared-independence date.)*
